look_here_first: Less-clasping leaves, typically capsule pore high near tip. Historical species name Triodanis biflora is a synonym.

morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate simple leaves; compare base and upper bracts
morphology_keys.flower: Individual five-lobed violet-blue corolla; lower closed flowers possible
morphology_keys.fruit: Inferior many-seeded capsule, openings need close inspection
